column1: # EXP-R2-230, instrument probe: what the float32 lens head reconstructs at each
# width and each precision, BEFORE any successor freeze is written.
# EXP-R2-229 measured its ladder at bfloat16 and `galactica-30b` was stopped by
# its own `verify_lens_head` at 8.569e-02 nats against a frozen 1e-2, on the TEXT
# cell, before any trajectory existed. The diagnosis in that entry is that the
# bfloat16 lens-head reconstruction floor scales with width. **That diagnosis is
# re-measured here rather than assumed**, and the float32 floor at width 7168 is
# measured beside it, because a precision chosen after seeing which rung a
# threshold refused would be a configuration fitted to a refusal. If float32 does
# not bring the top rung under 1e-2, the successor measurement cannot run as
# conceived and the tolerance is still not moved: a lens head that does not
# reconstruct the model's own logits is measuring nothing.
# `--stage verify` loads the checkpoint, builds the same head, the same grid and
# the same four cells `--stage measure` builds, and spends ONE forward pass per
# cell on verify_lens_head under a wide diagnostic ceiling, so an error above the
# frozen tolerance comes back as a number rather than as a stop. It computes no
# trajectory, no depth, no contrast and no gate, and none may be inferred from it.
# Every draw is the stage's own default, which is 21_joint_mode_qualification.py's
# default, which is the draw every Galactica rung was qualified under. Nothing is
# restated on the command line: a default spelled again in a manifest is a second
# declaration that stops tracking the first.
# Slots 1 and 2 are the three small rungs at the two precisions, three cards each.
# `galactica-30b` has slots 3 and 4 to itself, one precision each: 48 layers of
# width 7168 is about 57 GB of weights at bfloat16 and about 113 GB at float32
# against 143771 MiB of card, so it is a single-card cell and the float32 cell is
# the one that answers whether the successor measurement can run at all. An
# out-of-memory failure there is REPORTED as measured and is not retried smaller.
